newsitem.title: USA: GTSI revises Q1 EPS loss to $0.51.
newsitem.headline: GTSI revises Q1 EPS loss to $0.51.

text.p: Government Technology Services Inc said Thursday it had revised its first quarter results to show a loss of $3.4 million, or $0.51 per share.
It had previously reported a net loss in the quarter of $2.4 million, or $0.36 per share, but revised the results downward to reflect the exclusion of a $1 million tax benefit, it said.
Sales figures for the period remain the same: $88.4 million.
In the prior year's first quarter, GTSI posted a net loss of $1.8 million, or $0.27 per share, on sales of $82.79 million.
The company said it had to exclude the tax benefit because it was determined that certain net deferred tax assets did not satisfy recognition criteria under accounting rules.

As of May 15, GTSI remained out of compliance with certain 1996 year-end financial covenants contained in its credit facility. The company said it is currently reviewing a proposal from its principal lender to amend the terms and conditions of the credit facility.

GTSI said it expects to complete negotiations with its principal lender on or before June 30, and the principal lender has agreed to refrain from enforcing its rights with respect to such covenant violations on the condition that the company execute an amendment to the credit facility prior to that date.
The company said it expects that the final terms of the amended credit facility will neither adversely impact nor materially benefit its total borrowing costs in 1997.
GTSI is a government reseller providing broad-based information technology solutions.
